comparable_prior_wave.name: 2020-2021 medtech/procedure-recovery wave
comparable_prior_wave.similar: Procedure-volume recovery lifted device leaders; ISRG 3.0x 2020-03 to 2021-11 (tools.py px). OM and PRCT IPO'd into that wave (OM peaked 2020-11, PRCT 2021-10)
comparable_prior_wave.different: These names are post-IPO wreckage of that wave, and medtech waves are low-multiple: even the leader made 3x, nowhere near 25x. The current names are fragmented across unrelated sub-markets, not one theme.

themes.wave_score_reason: No shared theme; revenue is shrinking at SRPT, QDEL and ORGO, and the best historical analogue produced 3x for the leader.

comparable_prior_wave.name: 2020-2021 low-rate refinance/CRE-lending wave
comparable_prior_wave.similar: WD ran 6.2x as rates fell (tools.py px); LDI and WD are the same rate-sensitive exposure today
comparable_prior_wave.different: Rate-cycle recoveries are bounded (6x for the leader, RKT round-tripped); a 25x shape would need equity-stub leverage to work, which is what makes LDI/HTZ fragile.

themes.wave_score_reason: A rate-cut cycle could lift WD/LDI, but that is a cyclical recovery with a bounded prior analogue, not a white-swan theme; JACK/HTZ/ENVX share no theme.
